title: Classic Creamy Tomato Basil Pasta
description: Al dente penne tossed in a fragrant garlic, san marzano tomato and fresh basil sauce finished with parmesan.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook pasta according to package directions.
Heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes, sautéing for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer gently for 10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in heavy cream and grated parmesan until velvety.
Fold in drained pasta and fresh torn basil leaves. Season with salt and cracked black pepper to taste.

title: Avocado Chickpea Mediterranean Salad
description: Crisp cucumbers, creamy avocado, hearty chickpeas and cherry tomatoes tossed with lemon herb vinaigrette.
instructions: Rinse and drain canned chickpeas thoroughly.
Dice cucumber, avocado, and halve cherry tomatoes.
In a large bowl, whisk olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add chickpeas, diced vegetables, and chopped parsley to the dressing.
Toss gently until well coated and serve chilled.

title: Golden Turmeric Vegetable Curry
description: A comforting coconut curry packed with sweet potatoes, spinach, chickpeas, and aromatic warming spices.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Sauté diced onions, ginger, and garlic until golden.
Add turmeric, cumin, coriander, and garam masala, toasting for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add cubed sweet potato, diced tomatoes, and coconut milk. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Stir in chickpeas and cook uncovered for 5 minutes until sweet potato is fork tender.
Fold in fresh spinach until wilted. Garnish with cilantro and serve with steamed rice.

title: Zesty Chicken Fajita Skillet
description: Seared tender chicken breast strips seasoned with cumin and chili, tossed with sizzling bell peppers and onions.
instructions: Slice chicken breast into thin strips. Toss with cumin, chili powder, paprika, salt, lime juice, and 1 tbsp olive oil.
Heat a cast iron skillet over high heat with remaining oil until smoking hot.
Add chicken in a single layer and sear for 4-5 minutes until browned and cooked through. Remove to a plate.
In the same hot skillet, add sliced bell peppers and red onion. Sauté for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp with charred edges.
Return chicken to the skillet, toss together, squeeze fresh lime juice over top, and serve immediately.

title: Crispy Tofu & Broccoli Teriyaki Stir Fry
description: Pan-seared golden tofu cubes and vibrant broccoli florets tossed in a savory homemade ginger teriyaki glaze.
instructions: Press tofu with paper towels to extract moisture, then cut into 2cm cubes and coat with cornstarch.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or large pan. Fry tofu cubes on all sides until crispy and golden (approx 8 minutes). Set aside.
Add broccoli florets and minced garlic to the wok with 2 tbsp of water. Cover and steam for 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Whisk soy sauce, honey/maple syrup, grated ginger, and a splash of water in a small cup.
Pour sauce into the pan, return tofu, and toss vigorously over high heat until sticky and glazed. Sprinkle sesame seeds.

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.original_text: 1 large head broccoli, cut into florets

title: Avocado Poached Egg Sourdough Toast
description: Toasted artisan sourdough loaded with mashed seasoned avocado, runny poached egg, and chili flakes.
instructions: Toast sourdough slices until golden and crisp.
In a small bowl, mash ripe avocado with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Bring a small pot of water with 1 tsp vinegar to a gentle simmer. Create a vortex and drop cracked egg into center.
Poach for 3 minutes for a soft runny yolk. Remove with a slotted spoon.
Spread mashed avocado over toast, crown with poached egg, and finish with flaky salt and red pepper flakes.

title: Pan-Seared Lemon Herb Salmon
description: Crispy skin salmon fillets cooked in olive oil and basted with melted garlic butter, lemon juice, and fresh dill.
instructions: Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towels. Season skin and flesh generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a stainless steel or cast iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Place salmon skin side down. Press gently for 10 seconds. Cook undisturbed for 5-6 minutes until skin is crispy.
Flip salmon, add butter, smashed garlic clove, and fresh dill to the pan. Spoon foaming butter over fillets for 2 minutes.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the fish and remove from heat.

title: Rustic Roasted Garlic Tomato Soup
description: Slow-roasted vine tomatoes, caramelized onions, and sweet roasted garlic blended into a soothing silky soup.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Arrange halved tomatoes, sliced onion, and whole peeled garlic cloves on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, salt, pepper, and dried oregano. Roast for 25 minutes until caramelized.
Transfer roasted vegetables and pan juices to a blender or pot. Add vegetable broth.
Blend until smooth. Season to taste and ladle into bowls with a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Hearty Black Bean Vegetable Burrito Bowl
description: Fluffy cilantro lime rice topped with seasoned black beans, sweet corn, diced peppers, and creamy avocado.
instructions: Warm black beans in a small skillet with ground cumin, garlic powder, and lime juice.
In two serving bowls, divide warm cooked brown or white rice tossed with chopped cilantro and lime juice.
Arrange seasoned black beans, sweet corn, diced tomato, and sliced bell pepper over the rice base.
Top with sliced avocado, salsa, and a squeeze of fresh lime.

title: Classic French Herb Omelette
description: Silky, tender French-style rolled omelette with soft custard interior, rich butter, and fresh chives.
instructions: Vigorously beat eggs with a pinch of salt until completely homogenous and no whites show.
Melt butter in an 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium-low heat without browning.
Pour eggs in and shake the pan continuously in circular motions while stirring rapidly with a silicone spatula.
When curds are soft and custard-like with no liquid running, smooth the surface.
Roll the omelette gently onto a warm plate and brush top with melted butter.

title: Creamy Mushroom & Garlic Risotto
description: Arborio rice slowly simmered in rich vegetable broth with browned cremini mushrooms, white wine, and parmesan.
instructions: Heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet. Sauté sliced mushrooms until golden brown, then set aside.
In the same pan, sauté finely diced onion and garlic until translucent.
Add arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes until edges become translucent.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly and waiting until liquid is absorbed before adding more.
Once rice is creamy and al dente (approx 20 mins), fold in sautéed mushrooms, remaining butter, and grated parmesan.

title: Spicy Thai Basil Beef Stir Fry
description: Authentic Pad Krapow featuring savory minced beef, bird's eye chilies, garlic, and heaps of holy basil over jasmine rice.
instructions: Pound garlic and fresh chilies in a mortar and pestle into a rough paste.
Heat vegetable oil in a smoking hot wok. Fry chili-garlic paste for 20 seconds until intensely aromatic.
Add minced beef, breaking it up rapidly with spatula over high heat until browned and cooked through.
Stir in soy sauce, oyster/fish sauce, and brown sugar. Toss for 1 minute.
Turn off the heat, dump in fresh basil leaves, and toss until just wilted. Serve immediately over steamed rice.

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.original_text: 1 large bunch fresh holy basil or Thai basil

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.original_text: 2 tbsp dark and light soy sauce mix
